arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِبَقَاءِ وُلْدِي، وَبِإصْلاَحِهِمْ لِي، وَبِإمْتَاعِي بِهِمْ.
transliteration: allāhumma wa munnā ʿalayya bi baqāʾi waladī wa bi-iṣlāḥi-him lī, wa bi-imtāʿi bī-him
english_text: O God, be kind to me through the survival of my children, setting them right for me, and allowing me to enjoy them!

arabic_text: إلهِي أمْدُدْ لِي فِي أَعْمَارِهِمْ، وَزِدْ لِي فِي آجَالِهِمْ، وَرَبِّ لِي صَغِيرَهُمْ وَقَوِّ لِي ضَعِيْفَهُمْ،
transliteration: ilāhī amdid lī fī aʿmārihim wa zid li fi ajalihim wa rabbī li ṣaghīrahum waqawwilī ḍaʿīfahum
english_text: My God, make long their lives for me, increase their terms, bring up the smallest for me, strengthen the weakest for me,

arabic_text: وَأَصِحَّ لِي أَبْدَانَهُمْ وَأَدْيَانَهُمْ وَأَخْلاَقَهُمْ ، وَعَافِهِمْ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَفِي جَوَارِحِهِمْ وَفِي كُلِّ مَا عُنِيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ، وَأَدْرِرْ لِي وَعَلَى يَـدِي أَرْزَاقَهُمْ،
transliteration: wa'aṣiḥḥa lī abdānahum wa'adyānahum wa'akhlaqahum wa ʿāfihim fī anfusihim wa fī jawārihihim wa fī kulli mā ʿunītu bihi min amrihim waʾadrir li waʿalā yadī arzāqahum
english_text: rectify for me their bodies, their religious dedication, and their moral traits, make them well in their souls, their limbs, and everything that concerns me of their affair, and pour out for me and upon my hand their provisions!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْهُمْ أَبْرَاراً أَتْقِيَاءَ بُصَراءَ سَامِعِينَ مُطِيعِينَ لَكَ وَلأوْلِيَائِكَ مُحِبِّينَ مُنَاصِحِينَ، وَلِجَمِيْعِ أَعْدَآئِكَ مُعَانِدِينَ وَمُبْغِضِينَ آمِينَ.
transliteration: wa-jaʿalhum abrārān atqiyyā'a busarā'a sāmiʿīn muṭīʿīna laka wa li-awliyāʾika muḥibbīna munāṣiḥīna walijamiʿi aʿdāʾika muʿānidīna wa mubghidīna āmīn
english_text: Make them pious, fearing, insightful, hearing, and obedient toward Thee, loving and well-disposed toward Thy friends, and stubbornly resistant and full of hate toward all Thy enemies! Amen!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ بِهِمْ عَضُدِي، وَأَقِمْ بِهِمْ أَوَدِيْ، وَكَثِّرْ بِهِمْ عَدَدِي، وَزَيِّنْ بِهِمْ مَحْضَرِي، وَأَحْييِ بِهِمْ ذِكْرِي، وَاكْفِنِي بِهِمْ فِي غَيْبَتِي وَأَعِنِّي بِهِمْ عَلَى حَاجَتِي،
transliteration: allāhumma shudd bihim ʿaḍudī wa-aqim bihim awadi, wa kathir bihim addadi wa zayyin bihim mahdari, wa ahyi bihim dhikri wakfinī bihim fī ghaybatī wa'aʿinnī bihim 'alā ḥājatī
english_text: O God, through them strengthen my arm, straighten my burdened back, multiply my number, adorn my presence, keep alive my mention, suffice me when I am away, help me in my needs,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي مُحِبِّينَ، وَعَلَيَّ حَدِبِينَ مُقْبِلِينَ مُسْتَقِيمِينَ لِيْ، مُطِيعِينَ غَيْرَ عَاصِينَ وَلاَ عَاقِّينَ وَلا مُخَالِفِينَ وَلاَ خـاطِئِينَ،
transliteration: waajʿalhum lee muhibbine waʿalayya hadibeena muqbilīna mustaqīmeena lee muṭīʿīna ghayra ʿāṣīna wala ʿāqqīna walā mukhālifīna walā khāṭiʾīna
english_text: and make them loving toward me, affectionate, approaching, upright, obedient, never disobedient, disrespectful, opposed, or offenders!

arabic_text: وَأَعِنِّي عَلَى تَرْبِيَتِهِمْ وَتَأدِيْبِهِمْ وَبِرِّهِمْ، وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ مَعَهُمْ أَوْلاداً ذُكُوراً ، وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ خَيْراً لي وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي عَوناً عَلَى مَا سَأَلْتُكَ،
transliteration: wa'aʿinnī ʿalā tarbiyatihim wa taʾdībihim wa birrihim wa hab li min ladunka ma'ahum awladan thukuran wa-jʿal dhālika khayran lī wa-jʿalhum lī ʿawna ʿalā mā saʾaltuka
english_text: Help me in their upbringing, their education, and my devotion toward them, give me among them from Thyself male children, make that a good for me, and make them a help for me in that which I ask from Thee!

arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، فَإنَّكَ خَلَقْتَنَا وَأَمَرْتَنَا وَنَهَيْتَنَا وَرَغّبْتَنَا فِي ثَوَابِ ما أَمَرْتَنَا وَرَهَّبْتَنَا عِقَابَهُ،
transliteration: wa'a'ithni wa thurriyyati min ash-shaytan ar-rajim fa innaka khalaqtana wa amartana wa nahaytana wa raggabtana fī thawābi mā amartanā wa rahhabtanā ‘iqābahū,
english_text: Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan, for Thou hast created us, commanded us, and prohibited us, and made us desire the reward of what Thou hast commanded, and fear its punishment!

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتَ لَنَا عَدُوّاً يَكِيدُنَا، سَلَّطْتَهُ مِنَّا عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ، أَسْكَنْتَهُ صُدُورَنَا، وَأَجْرَيْتَهُ مَجَارِيَ دِمَائِنَا،
transliteration: wa jaʿaltalana ʿaduwwan yakeeduna sallaṭtahu minnā ʿalā mā lam tusallaṭnā ʿalayhi minhu ʾaskantahu ṣudūranā, waʾajraytahu majāriya dimāʾinā
english_text: Thou assigned to us an enemy who schemes against us, gave him an authority over us in a way that Thou didst not give us authority over him allowed him to dwell in our breasts and let him run in our blood vessels;

arabic_text: لاَ يَغْفُلُ إنْ غَفَلْنَا، وَلاَ يَنْسَى إنْ نَسِينَا،
transliteration: lā yaghfulu in ghafalnā, walā yansā in nasīnā
english_text: he is not heedless, though we be heedless, he does not forget, though we forget;

arabic_text: يُؤْمِنُنَا عِقَابَكَ، وَيَخَوِّفُنَا بِغَيْرِكَ،
transliteration: yu'minuna 'iqabaka, wa yakhawwifuna bighayrika
english_text: he makes us feel secure from Thy punishment and fills us with fear toward other than Thee.

arabic_text: إنْ هَمَمْنَا بِفَاحِشَة شَجَّعَنَا عَلَيْهَا، وَإنْ هَمَمْنَا بِعَمَل صَالِح ثَبَّطَنَا عَنْهُ،
transliteration: 'in hamamnā bifāḥishah shajjaʿanā ʿalayhā wa in hamamna bi'amal saalih thabbatna 'anhu
english_text: If we are about to commit an indecency, he gives us courage to do so, and if we are about to perform a righteous work, he holds us back from it.

arabic_text: يَتَعَرَّضُ لَنَا بِالشَّهَوَاتِ، وَيَنْصِبُ لَنَا بِالشَّبُهَاتِ،
transliteration: yataʿarraḍu lanā bi ash-shahawāt, wa yanṣibu lanā bi ash-shubuhāt
english_text: He opposes us through passions, and sets up for us doubts.

arabic_text: إنْ وَعَدَنَا كَذَبَنَا وَإنْ مَنَّانا، أَخْلَفَنَا
transliteration: ʾin waʿadana kaḏabna waʾin mannanā ʾaḫlanāfna
english_text: If he promises us, he lies, and if he raises our hopes, he fails to fulfil them.

arabic_text: وَإلاّ تَصْرِفْ عَنَّا كَيْدَهُ يُضِلَّنَا، وَإلاّ تَقِنَا خَبالَهُ يَسْتَزِلَّنَا.
transliteration: wa illa tasrif 'anna kaydahu yudhillana wa'ilā taqinā khabālahu yastazillanā
english_text: If Thou dost not turn his trickery away from us, he will misguide us, and if Thou dost not protect us from his corruption, he will cause us to slip.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَاقْهَرْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا بِسُلْطَانِكَ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنَّا بِكَثْرَةِ الدُّعَاءِ لَكَ، فَنُصْبحَ مِنْ كَيْدِهِ فِي الْمَعْصُومِينَ بِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma fāqhar sultānahu ʿannā bi-sultānik, ḥattā taḥbisahu ʿannā bi-kathrati ad-du'ā'i laka, fanuṣbiḥa min kaydihi fī al-maʿṣūmīna bika
english_text: O God, so defeat his authority over us through Thy authority, such that Thou holdest him back from us through the frequency of our supplication to Thee and we leave his trickery and rise up among those preserved by Thee from sin!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كُلَّ سُؤْلِي، وَاقْضِ لِي حَوَائِجِي، وَلاَ تَمْنَعْنِي الإجَابَةَ وَقَدْ ضَمِنْتَهَا لِي، وَلا تَحْجُبْ دُعَائِي عَنْكَ وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ، وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِكُلِّ مَا يُصْلِحُنِيْ
transliteration: allāhumma aʿṭinī kulla suʾlī, waqḍi lī ḥawāʾijī walā tamnaʿnī al-ijāba waqad ḍamintahā lī walā taḥjub duʿāʾī ʿanka waqad amartanī bihī waamnun ʿalayya bikulli maa yusliḥunii
english_text: O God, grant me my every request, accomplish for me my needs, withhold not from me Thy response when Thou hast made Thyself accountable for it to me, veil not my supplication from Thyself, when Thou hast commanded me to make it, and be kind to me through everything that will set me right

arabic_text: فِيْ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي مَا ذَكَرْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَـا نَسِيتُ، أَوْ أَظْهَـرتُ أَوْ أَخْفَيْتُ، أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُ أَوْ أَسْرَرْتُ،
transliteration: fī dunyāy wa-ākhiratī mā dhakartu minhu wa-mā nasītu aw ʾadhharatu aw ʾakhfaytu, aw aʿlantuu aw asrartu
english_text: in this world and the next, in everything that I remember or forget, display or conceal, make public or keep secret!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي جَمِيعِ ذلِكَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ بِسُؤَالِي إيَّـاكَ، الْمُنْجِحِينَ بِالـطَّلَبِ إلَيْـكَ، غَيْـرِ الْمَمْنُوعِينَ بِالتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُعَوَّدِينَ بِالتَّعَوُّذِ بِكَ، الرَّابِحِينَ فِي التِّجَارَةِ عَلَيْـكَ، الْمُجَارِيْنَ بِعِـزِّكَ،
transliteration: waaj'alnee fee jamee'i thalika min al-musliheena bisualaee iyyaka al-munjiḥīna bi-aṭ-ṭalabi ilayka ghayril mamnooʿeena bi-tawakkuli ʿalayk al-muʿawwadīna bi-ttaʿawwuthi bika, ar-rābiḥīna fī at-tijārat ʿalayka, al-mujār
english_text: In all of this, place me through my asking Thee among those who set things right, those who are answered favourably when they request from Thee and from whom is not withheld when they put their trust in Thee, those accustomed to seek refuge in Thee, those who profit through commerce with Thee, those granted sanctuary through Thy might,

arabic_text: الْمُـوَسَّـعِ عَلَيْهِمُ الـرِّزْقُ الْحَـلاَلُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ، الْمُعَزِّينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ بِكَ، وَالْمُجَارِينَ مِن الظُّلْمِ بِعَدْلِكَ، وَالْمُعَافَيْنَ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَالْمُغْنَيْنَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ بِغِنَاكَ،
transliteration: al-muwasʿaʿi ʿalayhimu al-rizqu al-halal min faḍlika al-wāsiʿi bi-jūdika wa-karamika al-muʿazzīna mina al-dhulli bika, wa al-mujārīna mina al-ẓulmi bi-ʿadlika wal-muʿāfayna min al-balāʾi birahmatika, wal-mughniyana min al-faqr bi-ghināk
english_text: those given lawful provision in plenty from Thy boundless bounty through Thy munificence and generosity, those who reach exaltation after abasement through Thee, those granted sanctuary from wrong through Thy justice, those released from affliction through Thy mercy, those delivered from need after poverty through Thy riches,

arabic_text: وَالْمَعْصومِينَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالزَّلَلِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِتَقْوَاكَ، وَالْمُوَفَّقِينَ لِلْخَيْرِ وَالرُّشْدِ وَالصَّوَابِ بِطَاعَتِكَ، وَالْمُحَالِ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الذُّنُوبِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، التَّـارِكِينَ لِكُلِّ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، السَّاكِنِينَ فِي جِوَارِكَ.
transliteration: wa al-maʿṣūmīna mina al-dhunūbi wa al-zzalali wa al-khaṭa'i bi-taqwāka wa al-muwaffaqīna lil-khayr wa al-rushd wa al-ṣawāb bi-ṭāʿatika wal-muḥāli baynahum wa bayna al-ḏunūbi biqudratika al-tārikīn li-kulli maʿṣiyatika, al-sākinīn fī jiwarika
english_text: those preserved from sins, slips, and offenses through reverential fear toward Thee, those successful in goodness, right conduct, and propriety through obeying Thee, those walled off from sins through Thy power, the refrainers from every act of disobedience toward Thee, the dwellers in Thy neighbourhood!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنَا جَمِيعَ ذلِكَ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَأَعِذْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ، وَأَعْطِ جَمِيعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَـاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي سَأَلْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
transliteration: allāhumma aʿtinā jamīʿa dhālika bi-tawfīqik wa raḥmatika wa aʿiḏnā min ʿadhāb al-saʿīr wa aʿṭi jamīʿ al-muslimīna wal-muslimāt wal-muʾminīna wal-muʾmināti mithla allaḏī saaltuka linafsī
english_text: O God, give me all of that through Thy bestowal of success and Thy mercy, grant us refuge from the chastisement of the burning, and give to all the Muslims, male and female, and all the faithful, male and female, the like of what I have asked for myself

arabic_text: وَلِوُلْدِي فِي عَاجِلِ الدُّنْيَا وَآجِلِ الآخِرَةِ،
transliteration: wa li waladī fī 'ājilid-dunyā wa ājilil-ākhirah
english_text: and my children, in the immediate of this world and the deferred of the next!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ عَفُوٌّ غَفُـورٌ رَؤُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ.
transliteration: innaka qaribun mujibun sami'un alimun ʿafūwun ghafūrun raʾūfun rahīm
english_text: Verily Thou art the Near, the Responder, the All-hearing, the All-knowing, the Pardoner, the Forgiving, the Clement, the Merciful!

arabic_text: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
transliteration: wa atina fi al-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan waqina `adhaba al-nar
english_text: And "give to us in this world good, and in the next world good, and protect us from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!
